sources: https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/60 (US eDirect API floridardr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 60, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facility 165, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: $29 a night for an RV: the $22 campsite fee plus Florida's $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $22), plus tax and a $6.70 reservation fee per reservation. No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over get half off the campsite fee.

fees.source: Reserve Florida search/details for every unit of facility 165 (all 24 'RV or Tent' units Rate 22.00, Fee 6.70), read 2026-10-21 + https://www.floridastateparks.org/fees ($7 nightly RV utility fee, as read 2026-10-12)

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/santos-trailhead-campground ('23 sites equipped with water and electric hookups') + Reserve Florida search/details, facility 165 (every unit Electric Hookup 50, Water Hookup yes; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park's pages disagree on the count: the main page says 23 sites, the Experiences & Amenities page '25-site Santos Campground'; Reserve Florida sells 24 (#001-#025, no #024). Site lengths on the booking site run 33-62 ft, all back-in.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/santos-trailhead-campground/experiences-amenities ('The 25-site Santos Campground provides power and water hookups for RVs, trailers and tent campers') + Reserve Florida search/grid + search/details, facility 165 (VehicleLength 33-62, PullInTypeName 'Back In' on all 24 units), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouse in the campground for registered campers; two picnic pavilions for campers.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/santos-trailhead-campground/experiences-amenities ('There is a bathhouse and dump station available as well'; 'Potable drinking water is available ... within the Santos Campground'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/santos-trailhead-campground ('the Santos Campground, available year-round for overnight trips'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/santos-trailhead-campground ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

note: On the Marjorie Harris Carr Cross Florida Greenway (state Office of Greenways & Trails), beside the Santos Trailhead's mountain-bike and equestrian trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: $29 RV ($22 + $7 utility), $6.70 reservation fee, 50-amp + water at every site, dump station, potable water, open year-round, reservable on Reserve Florida. Added max rig 62 ft (all back-in) and season. Site count conflicts between the park's own pages (23 vs 25; 24 on the booking site), recorded 25 with a note. Platform relabelled usedirect -> operator to match the state:FL row (same site). Showers left as derived (page says 'bathhouse' only). Cross Florida Greenway campground listed and booked by Florida State Parks, so state:FL fits. Note trimmed of field facts and the stale ReserveAmerica line.
flags: Phone missing: the campground's number is 352-369-2693 (floridastateparks.org park page); reservations 800-326-3521.
Site count disagrees between the park's own pages: 23 (main page) vs 25 (Experiences & Amenities); Reserve Florida lists 24 units.
